name: Delete Hostname Client Certificate
description: Delete Hostname Client Certificate Removes a client certificate used for authenticated origin pulls on a specific hostname. DELETE /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/origin_tls_client_auth/hostnames/certificates/{certificate_id}

name: Enable or Disable a Hostname for Client Authentication
description: Enable or Disable a Hostname for Client Authentication Associate a hostname to a certificate and enable, disable or invalidate the association. PUT /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/origin_tls_client_auth/hostnames
context:
PUT /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/origin_tls_client_auth/hostnames
Associate a hostname to a certificate and enable, disable or invalidate the association. If disabled, client certificate will not be sent to the hostname even if activated at the zone level. 100 maximum associations on a single certificate are allowed. Note: Use a null value for parameter *enabled* to invalidate the association.
Required: zone_id (path); body (body)

name: Get the Hostname Client Certificate
description: Get the Hostname Client Certificate Get the certificate by ID to be used for client authentication on a hostname. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/origin_tls_client_auth/hostnames/certificates/{certificate_id}

name: Get the Hostname Status for Client Authentication
description: Get the Hostname Status for Client Authentication Retrieves the client certificate authentication status for a specific hostname, showing whether authenticated origin pulls are enabled. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/origin_tls_client_auth/hostnames/{hostname}

name: List Certificates
description: List Certificates Lists all client certificates configured for per-hostname authenticated origin pulls on the zone. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/origin_tls_client_auth/hostnames/certificates
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/origin_tls_client_auth/hostnames/certificates
Lists all client certificates configured for per-hostname authenticated origin pulls on the zone.
Required: zone_id (path)

name: List Hostname Associations
description: List Hostname Associations List certificate ID - hostname associations for the given zone. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/origin_tls_client_auth/hostnames
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/origin_tls_client_auth/hostnames
List certificate ID - hostname associations for the given zone. Shows which hostnames are associated to which certificates for authenticated origin pulls.
Required: zone_id (path)
Optional: page (query); per_page (query); status (query)

name: Upload a Hostname Client Certificate
description: Upload a Hostname Client Certificate Upload a certificate to be used for client authentication on a hostname. POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/origin_tls_client_auth/hostnames/certificates
context:
POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/origin_tls_client_auth/hostnames/certificates
Upload a certificate to be used for client authentication on a hostname. 10 hostname certificates per zone are allowed.
Required: zone_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete Certificate
description: Delete Certificate Removes a client certificate used for zone-level authenticated origin pulls. DELETE /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/origin_tls_client_auth/{certificate_id}

name: Get Certificate Details
description: Get Certificate Details Retrieves details for a specific client certificate used in zone-level authenticated origin pulls. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/origin_tls_client_auth/{certificate_id}

name: Get Enablement Setting for Zone
description: Get Enablement Setting for Zone Get whether zone-level authenticated origin pulls is enabled or not. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/origin_tls_client_auth/settings
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/origin_tls_client_auth/settings
Get whether zone-level authenticated origin pulls is enabled or not. It is false by default.
Required: zone_id (path)

name: List Certificates
description: List Certificates Lists all client certificates configured for zone-level authenticated origin pulls. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/origin_tls_client_auth
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/origin_tls_client_auth
Lists all client certificates configured for zone-level authenticated origin pulls.
Required: zone_id (path)

name: Set Enablement for Zone
description: Set Enablement for Zone Enable or disable zone-level authenticated origin pulls. PUT /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/origin_tls_client_auth/settings
context:
PUT /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/origin_tls_client_auth/settings
Enable or disable zone-level authenticated origin pulls. 'enabled' should be set true either before/after the certificate is uploaded to see the certificate in use.
Required: zone_id (path); body (body)

name: Upload Certificate
description: Upload Certificate Upload your own certificate you want Cloudflare to use for edge-to-origin communication to override the shared certificate. POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/origin_tls_client_auth
context:
POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/origin_tls_client_auth
Upload your own certificate you want Cloudflare to use for edge-to-origin communication to override the shared certificate. Please note that it is important to keep only one certificate active. Also, make sure to enable zone-level authenticated origin pulls by making a PUT call to settings endpoint to see the uploaded certificate in use.
Required: zone_id (path); body (body)
